html:
Walk Home is a 5-minute psychological horror experience that puts you in the shoes of a young teenage girl, experiencing deeply unsettling circumstances as she navigates an eerie dirt trail back to her rural home late at night.

Key Features

  • Atmospheric environment and retro graphics.

  • VHS film aesthetic.

  • Receive texts from NPCs.

Recommendations

This is a 'late-night game' designed to be played in low-to-no-light conditions. It is recommended to play alone with the lights turned off to build atmospheric tension.

Controls

WASD - Walk

Shift - Run

Left Mouse Button - Interact

Right Mouse Button - Zoom
